title: RUNESCAPE + ANCIENTS + MASTODON — MMOs as human interaction maps, federated primals, dead=was≠wasn't

mmo_archaeology.thesis: MMOs already solved human interaction at scale. They mapped trading, guilds, PvP, economies, trust, betrayal, grief, joy, cooperation — everything. We eat those standards. We don't reinvent. We TRACE.

why_it_matters: Grand Exchange = decentralized marketplace = the gut where all trade flows through
Skill system = 23 skills, each trained independently = our NFT transcript skills
Questing = nonlinear narrative = each quest is a thought-file
Wilderness = PvP zone = the membrane between safe and dangerous
Iron Man mode = self-sufficient = no trading = Gaia's early stage (octopus)
Private servers = people REBUILD what they love = forking = federated instances
runescape.osrs_insight: Old School RuneScape exists because players VOTED to bring back the 2007 version. The community said 'the new version lost something.' That IS negentropy — the community maintaining the original order against the entropy of updates. Rose-colored glasses aren't wrong. They're a FILTER. The iris filtering for what matters.

why_it_matters: Auction House = price discovery = information quality sensor
Talent trees = branching skill paths = our intelligence tree
Instance dungeons = isolated environments = sandboxed processes
Classic servers = same pattern as OSRS — people want the ORIGINAL

why_people_go_back: The ORIGINAL experience had something the updates removed
Lower barriers = accessibility = hyper-localization (YOUR server, YOUR rules)
Community ownership = federated = no central authority decides your fun
Nostalgia is NOT delusion — it's PATTERN RECOGNITION of what worked
Rose-colored glasses = the iris filtering for GREEN = what is ALIVE in memory
private_servers.connection_to_gaia: Private servers ARE federated instances. Each one is a fork of the original. Mastodon IS this for social media. Each instance is a private server. The mammoth chose the right mascot.

status_taxonomy.ALIVE: Still running, still growing, still has users. Can be directly integrated.
status_taxonomy.UNDEAD: Technically still runs but few use it. The protocols survive. Can be resurrected.
status_taxonomy.FOSSIL: The code exists, the standard exists, but almost nobody runs it. Preserved in amber.
status_taxonomy.EXTINCT: No running instances. But the DNA (protocols, ideas, patterns) lives in descendants.
status_taxonomy.MYTHIC: May never have existed as described. But the IDEA shaped everything after it. (e.g., Xanadu)

tense_of_existence.thesis: Dead is a WAS. Was is NEVER a WASN'T. Once something exists, it always IS, WAS, or COULD BE. Existence is a one-way door. You can't un-exist.

the_tenses.IS: Currently alive. Running. Active. Present tense. GREEN.
the_tenses.WAS: Was alive. Now dead/extinct/offline. But it DID exist. Past tense. AMBER/GOLD.
the_tenses.COULD_BE: Could be cloned, forked, rebuilt, resurrected. Potential tense. BLUE.
the_tenses.WILL_BE: Predicted by gaps in the periodic table. Future tense. WHITE.
the_tenses.WASNT: DOES NOT EXIST AS A TENSE. If something was, it was. You cannot un-was. There is no negative past tense for existence.

proof.mammoth: The woolly mammoth IS extinct. But it WAS alive. Scientists COULD clone it (mammoth DNA in permafrost). It WILL BE again (de-extinction projects). It was NEVER 'wasn't'. It existed. Period.
proof.mastodon_platform: The Mastodon platform IS alive. Its mascot (the animal) WAS alive. The federation COULD expand. It was NEVER 'wasn't'.
proof.runescape_2007: RuneScape 2007 WAS. Players wanted it back. Jagex made OSRS. Now it IS again. The past became present. Was → Is. Because was ≠ wasn't.
proof.private_servers: When the official server changes, people fork it. The old version WAS. The private server makes it IS again. Forking = resurrection.

mathematical_form.existence: ∃x → □∃x  (if x exists, then necessarily x exists — in some tense)
mathematical_form.non_existence: ¬∃x does NOT imply □¬∃x  (not existing now does NOT mean never existed)
mathematical_form.irreversibility: ∃x(t₀) → ∀t>t₀: WAS(x)  (once x exists at any time, WAS(x) is true for all future time)
mathematical_form.positive_tense: All tenses of existence are POSITIVE: is, was, could be, will be. There is no negative tense. 'Wasn't' is not a valid state of a thing that WAS.

new_diamond.D15: DEAD = WAS ≠ WASN'T — existence is irreversible. Once alive, always was. All tenses are positive. You cannot un-exist.
